drug_authority.value: Licensees may prescribe medications according to professional discretion and judgment; controlled substance prescribers must comply with all state and federal laws and participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment.

license_status_types.quote: "Licensee" means a physician, resident physician, or physician assistant licensed to practice in North Dakota.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates must present evidence of a degree of doctor of medicine or board-approved equivalent, hold an ECFMG certificate, have a working ability in English, and complete 24 months of postgraduate training in a US/Canadian program accredited by a national accrediting organization approved by the board. Graduates of osteopathic schools outside the US are not eligible for licensure.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The applicant shall present evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has been awarded a certificate by the educational council for foreign medical graduates.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: must present evidence, satisfactory to the board, that the applicant has successfully completed one year of postgraduate training in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the board or by an accrediting body approved by the board.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility; opioids may not be prescribed through telemedicine for any other purpose.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as a federal food and drug administration approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility. Opioids may not be prescribed through a telemedicine encounter for any other purpose.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: A licensee who, pursuant to this chapter, prescribes a controlled substance, as defined by North Dakota law, shall comply with all state and federal laws regarding the prescribing of a controlled substance, and shall participate in the North Dakota prescription drug monitoring program.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to professional discretion and judgment. Opioids may only be prescribed through telemedicine if prescribed as FDA-approved medication assisted treatment for opioid use disorder or to a patient in a hospital or long-term care facility.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A licensee who has performed a telemedicine examination or evaluation meeting the requirements of this chapter may prescribe medications according to the licensee's professional discretion and judgment.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: May prescribe, dispense, administer, and procure drugs and medical devices
